video_title: Warriors not delivering payments to Kristaps Porzingis 👀 Shams has the details | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors withholding salary from Kristaps Porzingis while he is on the roster
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors will continue to withhold checks from Kristaps Porzingis as long as he's on the roster.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: How long do the Warriors plan to continue to not pay Porzingis and are they still trying to trade him?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: The Warriors will continue to withhold checks from Kristaps Porzingis as long as he's on the roster. That's over $218,000 per game that Kristaps Porzingis will be losing. The Warriors have ruled that Porzingis is not rendering services to the team. They have wanted him to show up to the team and be around the organization despite not being able to play, but he has not elected to do so as of yet.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors permitted to discuss Porzingis contract in trade market
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors are permitted to continue to discuss Porzingis's contract in the trade market.
quotes.quote: The Warriors are permitted to continue to discuss Porzingis's contract in the trade market. They're going to exhaust deals with rival teams that are essentially going to want salary cap relief in taking on Kristaps Porzingis. If the Warriors are able to find a deal with his near-expiring contract, they could then take on a larger contract, given another team draft capital as well, and for that other team, the upside is being able to clear money, save money overall, because from my understanding, Porzingis is willing to take a significant contract buyout on his deal to save another team a lot of money.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins names Houston Rockets as the best team in basketball
quotes.excerpt: The Houston Rockets are the best team in basketball. They are lacking nothing.
quotes.quote: The Houston Rockets are the best team in basketball. They are lacking nothing. They got a closer in Kevin Durant, actually two, Fred VanVleet, he showed us on the big stage in his championship run with Toronto. They got athletic wings, Amen Thompson and Tari Eason. They got a big in Alperen Sengun who's gotten better, he's been giving people that work. A bench, Marcus Smart, Reed Sheppard, they got options, right? And so when you think about my big list, we ain't going to the big board, but the Rockets leading the charge and they play with a level of physicality.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Alperen Sengun's impact on the Rockets' success
quotes.excerpt: Sengun is one of those ones that don't get talked about enough that give Joel Embiid problems.
quotes.quote: Sengun is one of those ones that don't get talked about enough that give Joel Embiid problems. I'm talking about tomato cans. I want all this action, move out the way, I'm finishing over you, I'm finishing through you. The well-coached Rockets need to take advantage of what's happening in the Western Conference because right now they have the deepest squad in basketball, they're the best team in the NBA. The center position, Stephen Adams, Sengun, and Clint Capela, so you need that going against Embiid if you're trying to make it out the West.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's leadership and impact on the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Fred VanVleet was an instant solution to their biggest problems last season and they're off and running.
quotes.quote: I think it's bold to put them above the Spurs, but I agree that they're a real deal contender. That's what we all thought they were going to be when they traded for KD. Everything changed when VanVleet went down. Fred VanVleet was an instant solution to their biggest problems last season and they're off and running. The reason they're a contender now is Marcus Smart. He helps and he helps more than people realize.
